title: final distribution licence and SBOM closure
scope: Closure over one installed candidate: installed bytes, registered licence originals, real link lines and both SBOM documents. Materials closure only; no runtime and no legal conclusion.

evidence_requirements.stage_kind: real reading-library install built by this workflow on the tested source
evidence_requirements.artifact_kind: named artifact authenticated by size, SHA-256 digest, expiry, workflow run and producing job upload log

checks_declared: materials_closed: every installed byte recorded, no missing, extra or drifted file
licence_closed: every registered original installed at its pin, no unregistered material, per-package materials present
link_closed: bundled archives and system libraries partitioned from the real link line, no overlap, no installed file named as a system library, every archive linked or declared unlinked

sbom_closed: SPDX 2.3 fields, per-file checksums, verification code, component licence identifiers, source references and licence CONTAINS edges; CycloneDX 1.5 components, licences, purls, file hashes and dependency refs
duplicates: every library shipped more than once recorded with its own path, owner, bytes and SHA-256
claims: runtime_accepted=false, legal_conclusion=false, product_granted=false, and any document asserting otherwise is rejected
not_granted: Runtime behaviour of the shipped binaries
Product, Release, signing, notarization, tag and store publication
Android, iOS and Apple host packaging and their host fonts
Optional package behaviour (sync, accounts, import, interface)
